title: KITH_BASE_URL prefix inconsistency unexplained
description: lib.rs reads KITH_BASE_URL (KITH_ prefix) while all current daemon config uses KITHD_ prefix. The KITH_ prefix is also used for legacy backward-compat vars (KITH_DB_PATH, KITH_OWNER_ID) that are being retired. KITH_BASE_URL is a present-tense active variable — not a compat alias — but uses the old prefix with no comment explaining the naming discrepancy. A reader cannot determine whether this is intentional, an oversight, or a variable scheduled for renaming. The KITH_* vs KITHD_* distinction is never documented anywhere.
